requiredContext.after: For each selected 3DG, the position of the additional 3DG is sampled from X ∼ N (µ, 2Σ), where µ and Σ is the mean and the convariance matrix of the selected 3DG.

After spawning, the 3DGs undergo optimization utilizing the same loss function (Eq.
(6)) as Stage 1.
Note that only the parameters of the additional 3DGs are optimized, while those of the transformed 3DGs remain fixed.

These additional 3DGs inherit their rotations and SH coefficients from the original 3DG, but their scaling is adjusted to 80% of the original, mirroring the 'split' operation described by Kerbl et al.[26]. Subsequently, we discard any additional 3DGs with opacity values below τ α to suppress the growth in the quantity of 3DGs.
